dedupe_keys.name: inies french reference database of environmental and health data for construction products fdes and pep

description: INIES is France's national reference database of environmental and health data for construction products and building equipment, used for building LCA under the RE2020 regulation. On 26 September 2026 its site showed 5,419 environmental and health declarations for construction products (FDES) representing 342,938 commercial product references, and 1,864 product environmental profiles (PEP) for equipment. The 2025 barometer reported, at the end of 2024, 6,324 data items including 4,560 FDES, 1,342 PEP, 1,691 default environmental data (DED) provided by the administration and 105 conventional data items. Declarations follow EN 15804+A2 and are verified by independent third parties; INIES is preparing for the new EU Construction Products Regulation from 2026. Coverage: products on the French market. Access: free public consultation of FDES and PEP online and a web service for digitised data feeding building LCA software. Licence: free consultation; reuse terms per declaration. Caveats: declarations are supplied by manufacturers, and default data are conservative placeholders. Simulation uses are embodied carbon inputs for RE2020 building LCA and renovation scenarios. Related records: ÖKOBAUDAT and EC3.
